Title: General availability: Deliver a secure hybrid workplace with Azure Virtual Desktop and Windows 365

Body.Content:
Microsoft Inspire – What’s new with Azure Virtual Desktop

We have some announcements coming up at Microsoft Inspire for Azure Virtual Desktop. Please join our sessions listed below to learn about what’s new and read our blog post for details.

  • New announcements to support our expanded vision for Azure Virtual Desktop to be a flexible cloud VDI platform for nearly any use case—accessible from virtually anywhere.
  • New Windows 11 support.
  • Remote app streaming with new per user access pricing and a new promotion are now available.
  • Our 30 percent off promotion for new Azure Virtual Desktop users is extended through the end of December 2021.
  • Product updates
    • Generally available: Start VM on Connect
    • New metadata storage locations in the United Kingdom and Canada
  • Microsoft Inspire sessions with live Q & A or on-demand:
    • BRK112 – New ways to grow your business with Azure Virtual Desktop
      • Session 1 - Thursday, July 15, 2:30 PM - 3:00 PM Pacific Time
      • Session 2 - Friday, July 16 6:30 AM - 7:00 AM Pacific Day Time
    • Ask the Experts with live Q & A – Azure Virtual Desktop
      • Session 1 - July 15, 10:30 – 11:00 am Pacific Time
      • Session 2 - July 16 - 5:30 – 6:00 am Pacific Day Time
